title: Bounded faithfully flat ind-etale extension to a w-contractible ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $\kappa$ be an infinite cardinal with $|A|\leq\kappa$. There exist a commutative ring $D$ and a faithfully flat ring map $A\to D$ [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] that is ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], such that $|D|\leq\kappa^{2^{2^{2^\kappa}}}$ and every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $D\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] has a ring retraction $B\to D$ (its composite with $D\to B$ is $\mathrm{id}_D$). The induced morphism of affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is a one-member pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering].

source.place: Tag 0983, proposition-find-w-contractible; Tag 0984, remark-size-w-contractible, cardinal bound for the constructed witness; Tag 0981, definition-w-contractible; covering clause by Tag 0989, definition-fpqc-covering, applied to a faithfully flat ind-etale affine morphism

proof.text: Set C to PrincipalWLocalization.StrictWCover.algebra A from [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover] to obtain faithful flatness, ind-etaleness, w-locality, and strictly henselian maximal local rings. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover-size] to obtain |C| ≤ κ, simplifying same-universe cardinal lifts.

source.place: Tag 0983, proposition-find-w-contractible, first sentence of proof; Tag 0984, remark-size-w-contractible, first three stages

proof.text: Use the compact Hausdorff totally disconnected component space supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback]. Its cardinality is bounded by that of Spec C, since ConnectedComponents.mk is surjective. Sending a prime ideal to its underlying subset injects Spec C into Set C, so |π₀(Spec C)| ≤ 2^|C| ≤ 2^κ. Cantor gives ℵ₀ ≤ 2^κ. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-extremally-disconnected-cover] at 2^κ to get an extremally disconnected profinite T and a continuous surjection t:T→π₀(Spec C), with |T| ≤ 2^(2^(2^κ)). The closed-point homeomorphism for C is not needed for this count.

source.place: Tag 0983, choice of T; Tag 0984, bound on the maximal ideal set; Topology Tags 090D and 090E

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback] to C,T,t. It gives the C-algebra D, ind-etaleness, a component homeomorphism eπ:π₀(Spec D)≃T, bijectivity of the canonical local-ring maps, w-locality, the inverse-image description of closed points, a homeomorphism from closed points to T, and spectrum surjectivity. A maximal ideal m of D gives a closed point whose contraction to C is closed, hence maximal. Transfer the strictly henselian instance of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover] across RingEquiv.ofBijective of the canonical localRingHom. The existing library instance Algebra.IndEtale.weaklyEtale gives flatness of C→D, and RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.iff_flat_and_comap_surjective gives faithful flatness using the supplied surjection. Give D the composite A-algebra structure. Existing library lemmas Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans and Algebra.IndEtale.trans give faithful flatness and ind-etaleness over A; the large conjunction theorem Sheaf.RingTheory.IndEtaleStability is not used.

source.place: Tag 0983, profinite pullback and preservation paragraph; Tag 097D; Tag 096C; Tag 096T; Algebra Tag 00HQ

proof.text: Transport ExtremallyDisconnected T through eπ.symm to π₀(Spec D). With w-locality and strict henselianity from the preceding step, apply [lem-weil-pbc-wcontractible-geometric-criterion] to each faithfully flat weakly etale g:D→B. The criterion accepts arbitrary universes, in particular B:Type(max u v), and gives r.comp g = RingHom.id D.

source.place: Tag 0982, implication (3) to (1); Tag 0983, final sentence

proof.text: Index localizations by M, the closed-point subtype of Spec D. Map d∈D to its images in every D_m. This diagonal map is injective: if two elements have equal images, apply the existing Mathlib theorem eq_zero_of_localization to their difference; every maximal ideal gives an index in M. For each m, the canonical local-ring bijection of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback] identifies D_m with the corresponding localization of C. Mathlib IsLocalization.cardinalMk_le bounds that localization by |C|≤κ. The supplied homeomorphism M≃T gives |M|≤μ=2^(2^(2^κ)). Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective, Cardinal.mk_pi, Cardinal.prod_le_prod, Cardinal.prod_const' and monotonicity of powers give |D|≤∏_M|D_m|≤κ^|M|≤κ^μ. The empty maximal spectrum is permitted throughout, including the zero ring.

source.place: Tag 0984, final paragraph: local rings, maximal ideal bound, and injection into their product

proof.text: The existing library weaklyEtale_SpecMap_algebraMap instance makes Spec D→Spec A weakly etale, since A→D is ind-etale. Its underlying map is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum], implemented by Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat. A morphism between affine schemes is affine and thus quasi-compact, by the existing instances for [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-affine-schemes-affine]. Unfold proetalePrecoverage to propQCPrecoverage WeaklyEtale and apply Mathlib Scheme.Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage. This directly verifies the singleton covering condition [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]; the separate tensor-product and faithfully-flat-base-change calculation is unnecessary.

lean.statement: theorem exists_bounded_wContractible_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) (hA : Cardinal.mk A ≤ κ) : ∃ (D : Type u) (_ : CommRing D) (f : A →+* D), f.FaithfullyFlat ∧ f.IndEtale ∧ Cardinal.mk D ≤ κ ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ κ))) ∧ (∀ (B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B] (g : D →+* B), g.FaithfullyFlat → g.WeaklyEtale → ∃ r : B →+* D, r.comp g = RingHom.id D) ∧ Presieve.singleton (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
